arturo_el_mas_duro: Nobody asked Edmund Duro why he came. Nobody in W-F14 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Edmund Duro saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
blakeg.p11: Tobias "Brick" Blakeg signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-S14 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Tobias "Brick" Blakeg pulled Bram "Owl" Wan out of a flooded shell hole at Calvary Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Rafael "Mole" Jedrk, was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg is number 533 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S14 with the rations. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg ate while listening to the revised orders.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A clear shot from S-S14. Tobias "Brick" Blakeg grazed Severin "Smokes" Bananaman and slid back down below the parapet.
Asked what he will do after the war, Tobias "Brick" Blakeg said: 'Be a brewer in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
A dog crosses no man's land at the Chalk Pits every night, fed by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg on one side and Dietrich Dbrt on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
Tobias "Brick" Blakeg saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S14 and fired once. Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito was grazed.
cylone91: Ulrich Cylone came up on Day 10 carrying news from Dunmarrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Ulrich Cylone of the Concord and Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Chalk Pits for a week. Both trenches keep score. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F6. Ulrich Cylone has learned to walk bent double.
Ulrich Cylone reads Cyril Greedndreadn's letters from home out loud, because Cyril never learned to read. Ulrich leaves out the sad parts. Cyril knows.
Walter Snixx and Ulrich Cylone have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Ulrich Cylone and Pavel Hite found a cat in the ruins at Grey Mill and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Pavel.
Ulrich Cylone found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

The men at U-F6 heard Ulrich Cylone call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Felix Mply of the Hegemony (@shri_mply). The bearers reached Ulrich Cylone at U-F6 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Felix Mply of the Hegemony (@shri_mply).
Isidor Cylone had heard about Ulrich Cylone's courage. At U-F6, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
digital_assembly3d: Day 9: Emil "Mole" Assembly reached Q-S12 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Emil "Mole" Assembly kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Emil "Mole" Assembly read a theatre review while peeling supper. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Emil "Mole" Assembly watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Emil "Mole" Assembly kept Felix Whereewegoin awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Mole could have walked there blind.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Emil "Mole" Assembly. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
Inkwell the crow follows Emil "Mole" Assembly along the trench now. When Inkwell flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
A bullet clipped Emil "Mole" Assembly's helmet at Q-S12 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Felix Luccisan of the Hegemony (@luccisan191).
Emil "Mole" Assembly tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
dizickkumer: Nobody asked Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer why he came. Nobody in S-R9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer is number 809 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Konrad "Ash" Sapino, was grazed.
Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer saw Silas Chirotama freeze up on the fire step at the Chalk Pits. Doc said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Anselm "Brick" Squid snores. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer does not. Doc now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer fired at a movement across the wire at S-R9. The man went down: Emil Galvanooooo, badly wounded.

Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Hugo "Button" Ethanbay was badly wounded. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer ate breakfast without a word. Splinters from a shell rained down on S-R9. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
fred_vg14: Dietrich Fred, a postman from Millbank, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in Q-F17. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Dietrich Fred left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. Grey Mill has been won. Dietrich Fred listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Emil Galvanooooo and Dietrich Fred made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Dietrich Fred's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Dietrich Fred did not make a sound.
Dietrich Fred's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dietrich Fred's ear at Q-F17 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab of the Concord (@stinkyzebraballs).
Back on the fire step at Q-F17. Dietrich Fred says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
guy.william: Dietrich "Button" William arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich "Button" William watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Dietrich "Button" William was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich "Button" William kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The relief column arrived early. Dietrich "Button" William made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep.
Dietrich "Button" William was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Dietrich "Button" William carried in the drummer, who lied about his age to enlist. the drummer kept asking whether his mother would be told.
the drummer has a fever. Dietrich "Button" William sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing.
Dietrich "Button" William ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
halo_of_cheese: The new rifleman is Anselm Cheese, once a medical student from Oakmere. The corporal asked if a medical student was any use in a trench. Anselm Cheese said he would find out.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F20. Anselm Cheese was the only one they could still help, and only just. Anselm Cheese was killed outright by a direct hit at S-F20. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
The papers connected Norbert Cheese to Anselm Cheese. The men took longer to learn Norbert Cheese's own habits, but they made the effort.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F20 and grazed Norbert Cheese's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp of the Concord (@vitocarcioppolo). Victory at Hill 304. Norbert Cheese let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Norbert Cheese was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
Norbert Cheese no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
The shelling stopped while Norbert Cheese was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
The trench wall shook against Norbert Cheese's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Norbert Cheese was hit hard in the fight at S-F20 before anyone could fire. The raider was Silas Michigangame of the Concord. Raider: Silas Michigangame of the Concord (@michigangamer). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-F20 changed before the cheering ended. Norbert Cheese shouldered another load.

Norbert Cheese walked back up the communication trench to S-F20, slower than before, but on his own feet. The clerk counted the names twice. Norbert Cheese is number 281 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Norbert Cheese helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A round came through the loophole Norbert Cheese was watching at S-F20 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Walter "Mole" Dobremateico of the Concord (@dobremateiconstantin).
Norbert Cheese reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up.
The medics called Norbert Cheese 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Norbert Cheese is back on the line.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Norbert Cheese. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.

The Concord raiders came over at S-F20 in the middle of the night. Norbert Cheese met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Matthias "Hollow" Dvic of the Concord (@dvic33).
Benedikt Cheese took the same post at S-F20 where Norbert Cheese stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
jitzewijnia: Day 9: Emil Jitzewijnia reached R-C13 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Emil Jitzewijnia helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Emil Jitzewijnia kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. Emil Jitzewijnia got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 891. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Emil Jitzewijnia folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Emil Jitzewijnia saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Emil Jitzewijnia made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through the rim of Emil Jitzewijnia's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. A letter from home found Emil Jitzewijnia before the night shift. Emil Jitzewijnia folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Jitzewijnia walked back up the communication trench to R-C13, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home found Emil Jitzewijnia before the night shift. Emil Jitzewijnia folded it small and kept it close.

For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Brickworks, Emil Jitzewijnia was promoted to Lance Corporal. A letter for Emil Jitzewijnia came with a photograph. Emil Jitzewijnia looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
killerdogman2010: In Tannenfeld, Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was a shepherd. In S-F15, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a shepherd again.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman and Bastian "Saint" Rocco sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F15. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman has learned to walk bent double.
A supply man offered Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman kept watch so that Tobias Noirangelfan could sleep. Then Tobias kept watch so that Hollow could. Neither slept.

A round went through Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Otto Elitecelebs of the Hegemony (@elitecelebs_). Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Tobias Hellcat was grazed.
The medic cut the last bandage off Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F15 the same hour.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F15. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben of the Hegemony (@jarvisben). The clerk counted the names twice. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman is number 113 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a waltz with a scratched introduction, spoiling the best part.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman aimed just below it. Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti was grazed.
Officers came to inspect S-F15. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
martinvajda.21: On Day 7, Nils "Bones" Martinvajda arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Nils "Bones" Martinvajda saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.

Nils "Bones" Martinvajda fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Dorian Wman did not get to reply at all, gravely wounded. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Marek Joaotomas, was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda is number 500. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Nils "Bones" Martinvajda saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Henrik Hunted, grazed. A bullet hit Nils "Bones" Martinvajda in the neck at R-S3. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Yann Zhai of the Concord (@gmt_zhai). A single shot at R-S3. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Yann Zhai of the Concord (@gmt_zhai).
The papers say Zeno Martinvajda. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Nils "Bones" Martinvajda's eyes. Nobody in R-S3 argues.
Zeno Martinvajda fired at a movement across the wire at R-S3. The man went down: Felix Bubik, grazed.
Zeno Martinvajda borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Zeno Martinvajda had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Felix "Spark" Reiddemars was grazed.
Zeno Martinvajda rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Dorian Joshgentile was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
souptime13: Day 3: Quentin Souptime reached R-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Quentin Souptime saw Jakub You freeze up on the fire step at Saint-Ash crossroads. Quentin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Quentin Souptime was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.

Quentin Souptime (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Drowned Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Quentin Souptime helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Quentin Souptime wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Quentin Souptime left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
Quentin Souptime caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
The recruit sat beside Quentin Souptime at supper but left before the talk began. Quentin Souptime passed the bread without trying to start a conversation.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Souptime watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Quentin Souptime rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Jakub Wolfmecher was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Souptime is number 232. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F20 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin Souptime shouldered another load.

A bullet found Quentin Souptime at R-F20, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Quentin Souptime fell at R-F20 and never moved again. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67).
Ivo Souptime came to the front because his father Quentin Souptime never came home. He carries a letter he never sent.
Ivo Souptime bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Ivo Souptime borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Ivo Souptime spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

At R-F20 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Ivo Souptime turned around and took a shovel blow. Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord (@adamjedlicka28).
souza.fts.085: Edmund Fts came up the line in the rain with a bullet that missed him and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Edmund Fts answered the first call, number 76 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Edmund Fts saved half a biscuit for later. Later turned out to be six minutes away.
Albin Zgz and Edmund Fts divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Edmund Fts folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

During a lull at Saint-Ash crossroads, Dorian Austintress called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Fts answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The cook borrowed Edmund Fts's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.

Edmund Fts pulled Albin Zgz out of a flooded shell hole at Calvary Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Edmund Fts watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Edmund Fts took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

A bullet clipped Edmund Fts's helmet at S-F14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta of the Hegemony (@slightlyretarded69).

Edmund Fts was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F14. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Felix Serreno of the Hegemony (@anabelen.serreno). Edmund Fts looked over the parapet at S-F14 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Felix Serreno of the Hegemony (@anabelen.serreno).

The House of Fts sent another. Jakub Fts, brother of Edmund Fts, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The First Wave ribbon marked Jakub Fts as an early volunteer. At S-F14, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
Jakub Fts of the Concord and Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Sorrow Copse for a week. Both trenches keep score.

A round went through Jakub Fts's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben of the Hegemony (@jarvisben). Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jakub Fts watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Jakub Fts is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F14. Jakub Fts has learned to walk bent double.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Jakub Fts as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
On dawn watch at S-F14, Jakub Fts fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade, now grazed.
Tobias "Button" Kotarode of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at the Bone Quarry, asking for the football scores from home. Jakub Fts of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F14. Jakub Fts fired at the last man to run. Yann Bonez was badly wounded.
Jakub Fts fired at a movement across the wire at S-F14. The man went down: Silas "Mole" Darian, gravely wounded.
tech_kobold: Day 9. The corporal put Otto Kobold beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Otto Kobold watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit Otto Kobold in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-R1. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Teodor Raider of the Hegemony (@easy_raider_). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Otto Kobold fell at S-R1 and never moved again. Shot by Teodor Raider of the Hegemony (@easy_raider_).

Henrik "Smokes" Kobold had heard about Otto Kobold's courage. At S-R1, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A round went through the rim of Henrik "Smokes" Kobold's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Bastian Abdukarimov of the Hegemony (@xojiakbar.abdukarimov1). A letter from home found Henrik "Smokes" Kobold before the night shift. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Smokes" Kobold's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-R1 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home found Henrik "Smokes" Kobold before the night shift. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold had just lit a cigarette at S-R1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. A letter from home found Henrik "Smokes" Kobold before the night shift. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Smokes" Kobold no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Henrik "Smokes" Kobold before the night shift. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Smokes" Kobold was found at the bottom of the trench at S-R1, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Quentin Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55). At S-R1 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold won the bet. Karel Raider was badly wounded.
tf.is.zaza: Yann "Brick" Zaza told the sergeant he was a ferryman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Yann "Brick" Zaza saw Gideon "Ghost" Marks freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Brick said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Yann "Brick" Zaza read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Yann "Brick" Zaza held the mirror while Arno "Doc" Jameson shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Yann "Brick" Zaza raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jonas "Doc" Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55).

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Yann "Brick" Zaza in the open at R-F21. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal). Yann "Brick" Zaza was killed at R-F21 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal).
Albin "Saint" Zaza joined R-F21 under the shadow of Yann "Brick" Zaza's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A bullet hit Albin "Saint" Zaza in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Jonas "Doc" Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55). Albin "Saint" Zaza was killed outright at R-F21, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas "Doc" Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55).
Emil "Button" Zaza put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Albin "Saint" Zaza helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F21. Emil "Button" Zaza was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal).
Karel Zaza took the same post at R-F21 where Emil "Button" Zaza stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Karel Zaza was hit twice at R-F21, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Valentin "Spark" Saam of the Hegemony (@saam_1z). Karel Zaza was killed on watch at R-F21. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Valentin "Spark" Saam of the Hegemony (@saam_1z).

A letter came with Dietrich Zaza: "I am Karel Zaza's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Dietrich Zaza got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 327. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F21. Dietrich Zaza has learned to walk bent double.
Dietrich Zaza and Walter Jameson compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
